title: Bridesmaids & Usher at Outdoor Wedding, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot taken on June 3, 1949, featuring three young women in puffed-sleeve formal gowns with floral headpieces and bouquets chatting together, while a young man in a classic late-1940s suit and bold patterned tie stands proudly beside a vintage automobile in a suburban residential neighborhood.
